text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I saw Kawakami Princess
looking awfully sleepy—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, it is no use~.
Why can one not defeat sleepiness with a punch~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She threw a few more punches after that, but it didn't
seem to help. She was clearly running on very little sleep.
